attributes.name: Druva - Download Outside Business Hours
attributes.description: Detects download outside business hours in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 5 – Data Access & Insider Risk

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 5 – Data Access & Insider Risk
meta.customer_usecase: Detects download outside business hours in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.event_type LIKE "*Download*" AND (DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp) < 7 OR DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", @timestamp) >= 19)
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
